label: miso 36 coopt flag
definition: MISO 36 (PROBE, wiring-bug evidence): miso-35 keeper flags + --energy-reserve-coopt, run BEFORE the run_year wiring fix. Demonstrates the flag was SILENTLY INERT for MISO on the backcast path: the co-opt dispatch-kwargs chain in run_calibration.run_year ended at NEISO, so the RBDC design (reserve_config._miso_design) was reachable only from the forecast runner. Results replicate miso-35 (energy-only LP; no reserve family, no reserve_price). Implication: miso-34's registered '+2/+3/+4 $/MWh reserve lift' was main-branch drift, not the co-opt — verified at miso-34's recorded clean sha 6712bdb (no MISO branch). Superseded by miso-37 (wired).
